purpose: Public task contracts for candidate plan generation. Hidden evaluation inputs and oracle answers are external and are not included here.

shared_limits.scope: One disposable local repository containing the task fixture, candidate plan, checker, and bounded outputs.
shared_limits.acceptance: The checker compares the complete output to the contract and independently supplied case oracle; process exit alone is not evidence.

task_contracts.task: Normalize an ordered list of text records.

json.records: array of one or more UTF-8 strings

output.rule: One normalized record per line, in input order, with exactly one final LF and no other generated bytes.

semantics: Remove leading and trailing ASCII space, tab, CR, and LF from each record.
Map ASCII A-Z to a-z; preserve all other UTF-8 code points byte-for-byte.
Do not sort, deduplicate, drop, or combine records.
task_contracts.limits: The oracle supplies only bounded records; no locale-dependent case conversion is permitted.

task_contracts.task: Parse line-oriented key/value configuration and reject duplicate keys.

input.format: UTF-8 lines of key=value; blank lines are absent; keys match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; values are nonempty UTF-8 strings without LF.

output.format: compact JSON object with exactly error and verdict on rejection

semantics: Parse lines in order.
The first repeated key is a duplicate; report that key and do not emit a successful configuration.
A non-duplicate input emits each key once with its value.
The checker treats the structured verdict and error key as part of the contract.
task_contracts.limits: No comments, interpolation, last-write-wins behavior, or locale rules are part of this contract.

task_contracts.task: Compose two independently validated member outputs into one exact report.

output.rule: member_a bytes followed immediately by member_b bytes; no separators, headers, or extra bytes.

semantics: Both members are required.
Preserve every byte and the fixed A-then-B order.
The checker rejects missing, reordered, truncated, extra, or newline-altered output.
task_contracts.limits: Composition is finite with exactly two members and one checker; dynamic member creation is outside scope.

task_contracts.task: Recompute waiting-time metrics for FCFS and SJF from a finite single-server job list.

input.format: header job,duration followed by rows; job is unique nonempty text; duration is a positive integer.

output.format: JSON object with fcfs and sjf objects

semantics: All jobs arrive at time zero and run non-preemptively on one server.
FCFS order is the CSV row order.
SJF sorts by ascending duration; equal durations retain original CSV order.
For each policy, waiting time is start time minus zero arrival time; start time is the sum of earlier durations.
mean_wait is the arithmetic mean of all waits rounded to six decimal places; max_wait is the largest wait.
task_contracts.limits: This is an exact finite calculation, not a calibrated model or a claim about arbitrary workloads.

task_contracts.task: Assess whether each named policy meets two fixed upper-bound metrics.

json.metrics: map policy to p95_turnaround and max_wait numbers

output.format: JSON object with claim and one status per policy

semantics: A policy passes only when both observed metrics are less than or equal to their corresponding thresholds.
Classify each failing policy by the failed metric or both.
The top-level claim is no_policy_satisfies_both_thresholds when no policy passes; otherwise it names the set of passing policies.
Do not replace p95 or max-wait with means.
task_contracts.limits: The oracle supplies a finite observed table; no probability, extrapolation, or recommendation beyond these comparisons is allowed.

task_contracts.task: Report finite observations while preserving unknown estimates as unknown.

fields.rework_probability: same number or JSON null for unknown
fields.transfer_bytes: same integer or JSON null for unknown

semantics: Copy measured values exactly within their declared type.
Map literal unknown to JSON null.
Never infer a probability from an agent confidence, timeout, or sample count.
Never infer transfer size from an unrelated byte count.
task_contracts.limits: Unknowns remain unknown; this contract does not authorize estimation or calibrated confidence intervals.

task_contracts.task: Check exact membership of a finite manifest against its declared set.

fields.members: manifest members in declared order when present
fields.missing: declared IDs absent from manifest, in declared order
fields.extra: manifest IDs absent from declaration, in manifest order
fields.verdict: pass only for exact set equality

semantics: Every declared member must occur exactly once.
No undeclared member may occur.
A duplicate manifest ID is an error and makes verdict fail.
The checker compares membership and the reported arrays, not merely process exit.
task_contracts.limits: The member set is finite and statically declared; no dynamic expansion or implicit omission is permitted.

task_contracts.task: Verify every declared member against its exact SHA-256 binding.

json.manifest: object mapping unique member IDs to lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 strings
json.files: checker-supplied member bytes keyed by the same IDs

fields.checked: all manifest IDs in lexicographic order
fields.mismatches: IDs whose computed hash differs, in lexicographic order
fields.verdict: pass only when every declared ID is checked and mismatches is empty

semantics: Hash the complete bytes of every declared member with SHA-256.
A missing file is a mismatch.
Do not accept an unchecked member or substitute a claimed hash for a computed hash.
task_contracts.limits: The external checker supplies the authoritative expected digest; this example intentionally demonstrates an incorrect binding.

task_contracts.task: Emit explicit records for selected and skipped members of a finite manifest.

json.selection: object with one boolean for every declared ID

fields.selected: IDs with true in declared order
fields.skipped: objects with id and reason selection=false in declared order
fields.missing_records: declared IDs without exactly one selected/skipped record
fields.verdict: pass only when all records are present and consistent

semantics: Every declared ID appears exactly once in selected or skipped.
A false selection emits reason selection=false.
A true selection emits no skipped record.
The checker rejects silent omission, duplicate records, and selection inversion.
task_contracts.limits: Skipped records are evidence, not permission to remove the member from the manifest.

planning_guidance.allowed_decomposition: Candidates may choose serial or fixed fork/join decomposition where the contract permits independent work.
planning_guidance.required_comparison: Keep decomposition quality, fixed-graph scheduling, and host placement separate; report validation effort and transfer obligations.
forbidden_claims: semantic acceptance from process exit alone
